prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a WIDE 16:9 landscape bitmap asset for one complete interior FLOOR of an interactive corporate tower website. This is an architectural dollhouse CUTAWAY: the ceiling and FRONT wall are removed so the entire floor and every room corner are visible, viewed orthographically from the front and slightly above, consistent 30-degree elevated camera. One continuous very wide rectangular office-floor module, roughly twice as wide as deep, filling 94% of image width with very little surrounding space. The module has a strong HORIZONTAL front slab edge and a matching back wall, is completely contained inside the frame with all four floor corners visible, and can be stacked vertically with other floor modules into a single building. NOT a whole exterior tower, NOT a standalone architectural poster, NOT a close-up office photograph. Rich polished stylized 3D game-world art with subtle pixel influence in plants and textures, tactile miniature detailing, premium graphite and brushed silver structural framing, teal-tinted glass on back wall, restrained warm gold architectural lighting, dark navy environment. Neutral premium corporate design, realistic comfortable furniture proportions, crisp readable layout. One floor only; no people or characters, no text, logos or UI, no task indicators. No black void occupying most of image. Include a narrow internal stair/elevator core at the far left so the floor is visibly part of a tower; do not attach stairs to an outside floating front door. Room remains open and spacious, warm and inviting. CEO FLOOR: top executive office interior. A refined executive desk with a single primary office chair, tasteful laptop and desk lamp, positioned to the right of centre facing the viewer. A large but uncluttered planning wall/whiteboard with abstract diagrams without readable words; a long elegant shelving wall; a small meeting table with two guest chairs to the left; a sofa corner and a few sculpted green plants. Large rear windows suggest high-floor skyline but no distracting huge city. Architectural materials and furniture should match an original Building Suit tower. A coherent complete floor, with circulation paths fully visible and generous open area between desk, meeting table and elevator core.
